group: Spain-wide discovery sweep — affiliated centres (centros adscritos) and anything the targeted agents might miss

programs.university: Universitat de Lleida (UdL) — Centre Universitari EAE (EAE Business School Barcelona)
programs.type: Affiliated centre of Universitat de Lleida (public)
programs.degree: Grado en Administración y Dirección de Empresas y Transformación de Negocios (marketed as 'BBA')
programs.language: Bilingual — Spanish with a 'bilingual Spanish/English study mode' (EAE FAQ: 'taught in Spanish, with a bilingual Spanish/English study mode'); Canal Universitats lists Catalan, English and Spanish. The English share is not stated (assume about half or less); there is no fully English stream.
programs.feb_start_evidence: Catalan Generalitat February preinscription lists 61077 'Administració i Direcció d'Empreses i Transformació de Negocis "Centre Universitari EAE"' (UdL, Barcelona, U. Públ. CA) with 44 places in Feb 2026 (39 places in Feb 2025); places are for the Feb–June 2nd semester. The Feb 2027 list is not yet published (normally out in January).
programs.application_deadline: NOT FOUND for 2027. Pattern: Feb 2026 round — preinscription 2–4 Feb 2026, assignment 6 Feb, enrolment 9 Feb (Feb 2025 round: 3–5 Feb). Expect early Feb 2027.
programs.application_fee_text: No fee is mentioned in the Generalitat Feb list PDF or on the EAE BBA page. EAE's own process: request info → interview → admission assessment → enrolment.
programs.deposit_text: EAE General Terms (Oct 2024): 'Admission does not imply that the Student's place on the Program is reserved. The place will be deemed fully reserved ... when payment has been made'. The amount of the initial payment/reservation is not published.
programs.refund_text: EAE General Terms (Oct 2024 English version): EAE refunds the amount paid ONLY if the Spanish consulate refuses the study visa after all documents were submitted AND after an 'administrative appeal for reconsideration' has been filed within the consulate's deadline. The student must submit the official visa-refusal notice (after the appeal). The student then chooses either (1) to use the money for an online programme of the same intake or (2) a bank-transfer refund minus bank and administrative costs. There is a 14-day no-reason withdrawal right after contracting. Otherwise payments are not refunded.
programs.tuition_text: EAE FAQ: 'tuition fee ... is €9,900 for the October 2026 intake' (annual; an aggregator snippet gave €11,500 for the English/bilingual format, unverified). The Generalitat Feb 2026 list gives an indicative price of €5,750 for the Feb–June semester only, labelled 'preu orientatiu ... només a la matrícula del 1r quadrimestre (febrer-juny)'. No non-EU surcharge is stated (private affiliated-centre pricing). 2027 prices not published.
programs.graduate_route: Conditional. Two possible routes, neither confirmed for a February start: (a) Catalan February preinscription (accesuniversitat.gencat.cat) — a foreign graduate needs a recognised access credential (homologated degree for the 'titulats universitaris' reserve quota, or UNEDasiss/homologated secondary school); (b) direct admission as a holder of 'estudios universitarios extranjeros parciales o totales' not homologated in Spain — UdL lists this as an access route (RD 534/2024); in Spanish practice this route normally requires the university to recognise at least 30 ECTS of the previous degree (the 30-ECTS threshold was not quoted on the UdL page itself — verify with the centre).
programs.language_requirement: NOT FOUND (no formal English or Spanish certificate stated). Because most of the teaching is in Spanish or bilingual, the applicant would in practice need Spanish.
programs.official_ruct: Yes (RUCT code 1500095 — Graduado/a en ADE y Transformación de Negocios por la Universidad de Lleida, centre 08073430 Centro Universitario EAE; plan published in BOE 24/03/2025)
programs.data_year: 2026 (Feb 2026 round, Oct 2026 price) — 2027 figures not yet published
programs.visa_timing_note: Poor fit. Places are assigned in the Catalan Feb preinscription in early Feb 2027, so an admission letter by early Dec 2026 is unlikely through that route. An earlier letter would only be possible if EAE/UdL admit him directly through recognition of foreign university credits, which is unconfirmed. He must ask EAE admissions whether they issue conditional letters for the Feb intake.
programs.risks: (1) LANGUAGE: Spanish/bilingual, with no fully English stream — conflicts with the English/French-only requirement. (2) The Feb entry runs through the public Feb preinscription, whose results come out in Feb, which is too late for a visa. (3) The Feb list for 2027 is not yet published, so the places could change. (4) The visa refund requires a consular appeal first, and admin/bank costs are kept.

ESIC's own site advertises only September starts, so the Feb entry exists only through the Catalan Feb round (16 places in 2026; 2027 places unknown). Feb preinscription timing does not fit a visa. This is the only fully English-taught Feb option I found outside the other agents' lists.

notes:
DISCOVERY-SWEEP FINDINGS (English/French requirement applied):
1) No French-taught official grado with a Jan/Feb start was found anywhere in Spain. French-taught options in Spain are either Sept-only public 'Estudios Franceses' / Franco-Spanish double degrees (UPO, US, UAM, UGR, UM...) or foreign French degrees (TBS Barcelona — French Bachelor in Management, Sept intake, not a Spanish grado).
2) The only mechanism outside the other agents' lists that gives an OFFICIAL Feb start is the Catalan Generalitat 'Convocatòria de febrer' (preinscripció). Its Feb 2026 list includes affiliated centres NOT on the coordinator's covered list: Centre Universitari EAE (UdL) — ADE i Transformació de Negocis (44 places) and Màrqueting i Comunicació Digital (45 places), both Spanish/bilingual; Barcelona Culinary Hub (UB) — Direcció i Gestió Gastronòmica (10); Eina (UAB) — Disseny (5); Elisava (UVic) — Disseny i Innovació (12); UAB affiliated 'Turisme (docència en Anglès)' (5 places, Cerdanyola) and 'Direcció Hotelera' (10). ENGLISH-TAUGHT items in that list: ESIC Barcelona (URV) Màrqueting in English (16 places, B2), CETT Turisme in English (covered), UAB-affiliated Turisme in English (likely covered by the UAB agent — please confirm), UVic Global Studies in English (covered). Feb 2025 list also had Euroaula and Mediterrani (UdG) Turisme and Dret ESERP — absent in 2026. The Feb 2027 list will only be published around January 2027.
3) BIG CAVEAT for all Catalan Feb-round places: preinscription is in early Feb (2026: 2–4 Feb, assignment 6 Feb, enrolment 9 Feb), so a non-EU applicant cannot get an admission letter by early Dec 2026 through that route. The only way around it is a direct admission/credit-recognition route (foreign university studies with at least 30 ECTS recognised), which must be confirmed with each centre.
4) Outside Catalonia, the only public-university Feb entry for NEW students found is Universidad de León ('Admisión Segundo Semestre': apply 18–22 Jan 2027, degrees with vacancies only, Spanish-taught). Valladolid's 2nd enrolment period (26 Jan–4 Feb 2027) is only for extending enrolment and for new students in official MASTER's degrees (search snippet, not fetched). Zaragoza's January 'ampliación' is for current students only.
5) Affiliated centres outside Catalonia that were checked (Florida, EDEM, Cardenal Cisneros, TAI, CEDEU, IEB, CESAG, San Isidoro, ESERP Madrid) are all September-only and mostly Spanish-taught.
6) English-taught options WITH a Jan/Feb start do exist but are NON-OFFICIAL in Spain: GBSB Global (Maltese degree, authorised foreign centre in RUCT 08073661, Jan start), EU Business School (UVic título propio + Swiss + UK, Feb start), CEDEU English BBA (180 ECTS, partner degree, Feb start), SLU Madrid (US, Jan start, visa deadline already passed), Schiller (US), Les Roches Marbella (US NECHE BSc), Harbour.Space (rolling, non-official). If the applicant could accept a foreign EHEA degree, GBSB (Malta, MQF/EQF 6) is the closest English January option — but it is NOT a Spanish grado.
7) Not checked because the web-search budget ran out: Ramon Llull faculties other than La Salle (ESADE BBA, IQS, Blanquerna, Sant Ignasi/HTSI — URL does not take part in the public Feb preinscription; ESADE/IQS bachelors are believed to be Sept-only), UNIBA (UB affiliate — absent from both Feb lists, so no Feb preinscription entry), Mondragon LEINN International (believed Sept-only; first application deadline 7 Feb for Sept), Universidad Loyola, San Jorge, UCV, UIE, UNIE, Vatel Madrid (site down), Suffolk Madrid (US degree), CES Felipe II, ESCUNI, EAE Madrid (URJC) bachelor intake.
8) Useful contacts: SLU Madrid admissions-madrid@slu.edu; ESERP international info via eserp.com (+34 91 350 12 12); EAE Barcelona collections gestioncobros@eae.es (+34 93 499 38 40); GBSB info@global-business-school.org.
